description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Simbe Robotics is a leading retail robotics company providing in-store intelligence solutions that help retailers optimize operations. They are seeking a Robotics Software Test & QA Engineer to ensure the performance, reliability, and quality of their robotics software through strong testing practices and collaboration with software engineers.
Robotics software QA engineer for automated regression testing, triage, and release validation

Responsibilities:
• Work closely with software engineers to develop testing practices, improve testability, and build automated tests
• Constantly monitor (manually and automatically) our fleet of local test robots and run continuous regression tests
• Support triage, debugging, and root cause analysis of issues discovered through automated and manual testing
• Assist with robot setup, configuration, and validation in support of internal testing and release readiness
• Document issues methodically, providing clear visibility into reproduction steps, impact, and resolution status
• Continuously improve test tooling, pipelines, and quality signals to increase the speed and quality of defect detection

Requirements:
• Deep working knowledge of Linux systems and command-line tools
• Working competence scripting in languages like Python (or similar)
• Understanding of C++ and Python code (reading/debugging across both)
• Experience with testing frameworks like gtest (or similar test frameworks)
• Exposure to cloud infrastructure and modern CI/CD practices
• Familiarity with statistics or data-science tools & methods
• Strong understanding of wired and wireless networking concepts (IPv4, NetworkManager, WPA2 security, etc.)
• Methodical and detail-oriented in debugging, triaging, and documenting issues
• Calm, patient, and communicative, especially when collaborating across teams
• Comfortable resolving unknown problems using research, experimentation, and AI tools

Preferred:
• Bachelor's degree in a related discipline
• Familiarity with robot operating systems (ROS/ROS2) and related tools
• Prior experience testing or supporting autonomous robots, embedded systems, or distributed systems
• Familiarity with remote monitoring and diagnostic tools for distributed systems
